description: §14.8.10 corollary (S456) — the same login with the identity read marked `.acrossTenants()` (one of the two fixes W-TENANT-SUBSTRATE-SCOPED names): the read is deliberately unscoped (I-TENANT-ACROSS) and no W-TENANT-SUBSTRATE-SCOPED fires.
rationale: §14.8.10: "Corollary: the identity/grant substrate (`users` / `user_roles`) is NOT tenant-scoped"; `.acrossTenants()` is the sole loud tenant opt-out.
